comments:
Kashmirian scholar. Can be identified with the Indian expert in the five domains of knowledge who compile a comparative catalog of Chinese and Tibetan Buddhist translated scriputres in Dadu between 1285 and 1287. May also be the Vimalaśrī or
Vimalaśrībhadra active at Sa skya during the middle of the second half of the 13th century, and known as translator of canonical works. He was a son of Śākyaśrībhadra's nephew Bhūmiśrī ([FEHIEFEB]: 163-164).
name: vimalaśrī
